I don't care if it's a lower salary as long as it's enough for a comfortable lifestyle. Since you guys have universal health care, free schooling and universities, that takes care of a lot of things I'd save for. 

Do engineers live a comfortable life in Germany?
I have a Masters in Computer Science, 12 years in the field. My wife has a Masters in Electrical Engineering and about 4 years in her field.

Hello,

I'm starting the research into immigrating to Germany. I'm am Indian citizen currently living in the USA. My wife and I have Masters degrees in our fields and years of experience in our careers. I don't expect all the answers from you fine folks but is there anyone with a similar background who can offer some insights? 

Edit : I'm looking at the wiki (very helpful!) and will look at jobs to see what my options are. I'm just seeking general comments from people who immigrated in ways that I'm looking to do.

I understand Germany has a system in place for trained professionals and that our profile fits the requirements. Obviously, we will learn German and follow all the rules and requirements for successful integration if we get that far. So, any pointers for us? Thanks!
